callouts.label: Making a Place Together
callouts.hint: Find the adult and child spreading a colorful blanket on the grass.
callouts.description: Families work together to make places where everyone can rest, eat, play, and feel included.

callouts.label: Sharing Food and Traditions
callouts.hint: Find the low table filled with colorful foods shared by several people.
callouts.description: Families can share foods, stories, and traditions that help children feel connected to the people and cultures they belong to.

callouts.label: Listening to a Story
callouts.hint: Find the older adult reading a blank picture book beneath the large tree.
callouts.description: A caring adult gives children attention, listens to their ideas, and shares knowledge through stories.

callouts.label: Sun Safety Together
callouts.hint: Find two adults helping a child with a sun hat and sunscreen.
callouts.description: Care can be practical: trusted adults help children prepare for safe, comfortable outdoor play.

callouts.label: Comfort and Listening
callouts.hint: Find the adult kneeling beside a child near the center path.
callouts.description: Trusted adults listen to small questions and worries, offer comfort, and help children feel safe.

callouts.label: Everyone Joins the Game
callouts.hint: Find three children playing with a bright ball, including a child using a wheelchair.
callouts.description: Families and friends can adapt play so every child has a real way to join, contribute, and have fun.

callouts.label: Offering Water
callouts.hint: Find the adult pouring water from a clear pitcher at the picnic table.
callouts.description: Care includes noticing what bodies need, such as water, food, rest, shade, and help.

callouts.label: A Warm Welcome
callouts.hint: Find two groups greeting one another beneath the shade canopy.
callouts.description: Families can be big or small and organized in many ways. Welcoming others shows that every caring family belongs.
